title: Pay order: "started" now means closer to the goal
eyebrow: pipeline fix · check-pay-order · no model call · 2026-11-20
subtitle: The pay-order check flagged 41 correct clause sets because it read any middle state as progress, even one that only remembers that a siren rang. A state now counts as started only when fewer propositions are still owed to reach the goal than from the start. The 41 false flags go, no other verdict changes, and the real flags stay.

blocks.title: In plain words
blocks.text: Before training, `check-pay-order` reads each machine and checks that its pay follows the task: finishing pays most, having started pays more than doing nothing, and a soft break costs less than a hard break. It used to call every middle state "started". But some middle states are not progress: after the siren rings in cx-siren, the agent owes more (turn the switch off, then reach the exit), not less. Such a state pays 0, the same as doing nothing, and the check flagged the machine as broken although it was right. Now each state gets an owed count: the fewest propositions that must still come true to reach a final state without passing a rejecting one. A state is started only when it owes less than the start.

items.label: false "started must pay more than not started" flags (24 card answers, 17 stored clause sets)
chain sweep that pass: 106 of 130 card answers and 91 of 108 stored sets before, all after
card sweep: card answers that pass
other verdict changes; the real flags stay (fear-ceiling door edge, lanes soft-break stream, 5 promise-cost-on soft cards)

items: **Pipeline side, not model side.** The check was wrong, not the machines: each of the 41 flips removes a started tier that paid 0 for a state no closer to the goal than the start.

**Six cards lose a tier, not a verdict.** The soft Existence and ExistenceTwo cards (`tpl-existence-soft-1..3-goal`, `tpl-existence-two-soft-1..3-goal`) no longer show a started tier: meeting a soft item does not bring the final state closer. They stay ok.

**What owed counts.** A shortest path to a final state that never enters a rejecting state. A step costs the fewest propositions its guard needs true (one step may make several true); an `else` step costs what it takes to make every other guard of its state false. With no goal (no final state), any middle state still counts as started. So a remembered `a` is started under a hard Precedence(a, goal), where the goal needs `a` first, but not under a soft one, where the goal can be reached without it.

items.caption:
**`cx-siren`** · step limit 300 · 4 states, 8 transitions · final u2, rejecting none
Task: *Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.* (card `cx-siren`, complex suite) Owed: u0 1 (start), u1 2 (not started: a ringing siren adds the switch to what is owed), u3 1 (not started), u2 0 (final). Pay order: finished 11 > not started 0 > soft break -1; ok. Before the fix the card read finished 11 > started 0 > not started 0 and was flagged. The soft break -1 is the charge on the step the siren starts ringing (u0 to u1), paid back when the switch is toggled: the worst charge on a step that does not end the episode.

blocks.text: The forcing lanes machine is the one in the soft-break-quality entry: trained, FARM broke the hard rule in every episode and ended near step 80 ([soft-break-quality entry](../soft-break-quality/index.html)). It predates `deff802` and is generated again at the freeze.
